title: Ground floor
subtitle: Numbers, units, change, uncertainty, the body's chemistry, and reading evidence
coverLine: The foundation every later book stands on
author: Dr. Harsh Maheshwari

about.why: Every other book in this series stands on this one. It teaches, once, the ground floor the other 195 books assume: numbers you can trust, units and dimensions, relationships and change, uncertainty, the chemistry of a body, and how to read evidence. It assumes you can read English and use a calculator. It assumes nothing else: no medicine, no biology, no remembered mathematics.
about.howToRead: Read it in order. Each section assumes everything before it and nothing after it. If a section looks easy, read it anyway and read it quickly: it is here because something later needs it.

blurb: Forty-three short sections that take you from place value to reading a statute: the arithmetic, units, graphs, probability, measurement, energy and biology that every later book in the series takes for granted. Every claim is checked against a source you can open. Every worked answer is recomputed. Every section ends with exercises and practice problems you can do.
